air-bench-audio.description: Open-ended, instruction-following audio tasks across speech/sound/music/mixed audio; dynamic foundation-model-judged scoring.

airs-bench.description: End-to-end AI research-science work by agents, official multi-agent leaderboard (Meta).

assistantbench.description: Long, realistic live-web research/assistant tasks requiring planning, retrieval, and synthesis.

assistgui.description: Desktop GUI automation (Windows) across productivity software (After Effects, MS Word) via screenshots.

astabench.description: AI2's grounded scientific-research-agent benchmark: 4 categories (literature search, code, data analysis, end-to-end discovery). ICLR 2026 oral.

audiobench.description: Universal audio-LLM benchmark: ASR, speech QA, instruction following, audio captioning, emotion/accent/gender recognition across 26 datasets. NAACL 2025.

babilong.description: Long-context reasoning built on the classic bAbI tasks, extended to very long documents.

balrog.description: Text-based game-playing across six environments of increasing difficulty, from simple grid tasks to complex dungeon exploration (NetHack).

bfcl.description: The standard tool/function-calling eval: single-turn, multi-turn, parallel and nested calls across Python/Java/JS/SQL/REST; v4 adds agentic eval.

big-bench-hard.description: 23 hand-picked "hard" tasks from BIG-Bench where earlier models scored below average human raters — multi-step logical/algorithmic/commonsense reasoning.

bigcodebench.description: Diverse function-calls + complex multi-step instructions, harder/broader than HumanEval; active leaderboard.

bird-sql.description: 12,751 question/SQL pairs, 95 databases, 37 domains; standard cross-domain text-to-SQL benchmark, usually reported alongside Spider.

blueprint-bench-2.description: Whether an agent can construct an accurate 2D floor plan of an apartment from a set of interior photographs, scored against the true room layout.

bool-q.description: Naturally-occurring yes/no reading-comprehension questions paired with a supporting Wikipedia passage.

points.org: Large Model Systems Organization,University of California (UC) Berkeley

browsecomp.description: Persistent, multi-hop web browsing to surface hard-to-find, entangled facts — designed to resist saturation by non-agentic models.

btf3.description: An Epoch-hub-tracked benchmark (bulk-imported; no dedicated deep-dive in this research pass).

cad-eval.description: Whether a model can produce correct computer-aided-design (CAD) outputs from a specification.

casehold.description: 53,000+ MC questions identifying legal holdings from real US case law; part of the LegalBench suite.

chartqa.description: Question answering over bar/line/pie charts, requiring both visual reading and arithmetic reasoning over the chart's data.

chess-puzzles.description: Best-next-move identification from chess positions (in FEN notation), judged against the Stockfish engine — a lightweight spatial-reasoning/planning probe.

cl-bench.description: An Epoch-hub-tracked "continual learning"-flavored benchmark (bulk-imported; no dedicated deep-dive in this research pass).

cl-bench-life.description: A "life"/everyday-tasks variant of CL-Bench (bulk-imported; no dedicated deep-dive in this research pass).

finben.description: Holistic financial-LLM benchmark, 8-axis taxonomy. NeurIPS 2024 Datasets & Benchmarks track.
